import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder


def one_hot_encoder(df: pd.DataFrame,columns=None,encode_all=False) -> pd.DataFrame:

    result = df.copy()
    if columns is not None:
        pass

    elif encode_all:
        columns = result.columns.tolist()
    else:
        columns = result.select_dtypes(
            include=["object", "category"]
        ).columns.tolist()

    if len(columns) == 0:
        return result

    encoder = OneHotEncoder(
        sparse_output=False,
        handle_unknown="ignore"
    )

    encoded = encoder.fit_transform(result[columns])

    encoded_df = pd.DataFrame(
        encoded,
        columns=encoder.get_feature_names_out(columns),
        index=result.index
    )

    result = result.drop(columns=columns)
    result = pd.concat([result, encoded_df], axis=1)

    return resultroot@e123fae6e01b:/app# cat /app/src/transform/StandardScaler.py
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler


def standard_scaler(df: pd.DataFrame, columns=None) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Standardize selected columns.
    """
    result = df.copy()

    if columns is None:
        columns = result.select_dtypes(include=["number"]).columns.tolist()

    if len(columns) == 0:
        return result

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    result[columns] = scaler.fit_transform(result[columns])

def one_hot_encoder(df: pd.DataFrame,columns=None,encode_all=False) -> pd.DataFrame:

    result = df.copy()
    if columns is not None:
        pass

    elif encode_all:
        columns = result.columns.tolist()
    else:
        columns = result.select_dtypes(
            include=["object", "category"]
        ).columns.tolist()

    if len(columns) == 0:
        return result

    encoder = OneHotEncoder(
        sparse_output=False,
        handle_unknown="ignore"
    )

    encoded = encoder.fit_transform(result[columns])

    encoded_df = pd.DataFrame(
        encoded,
        columns=encoder.get_feature_names_out(columns),
        index=result.index
    )

    result = result.drop(columns=columns)
    result = pd.concat([result, encoded_df], axis=1)

def standard_scaler(df: pd.DataFrame, columns=None) -> pd.DataFrame:

    result = df.copy()

def one_hot_encoder(df: pd.DataFrame,columns=None,encode_all=False) -> pd.DataFrame:

    result = df.copy()
    if columns is not None:
        pass

    elif encode_all:
        columns = result.columns.tolist()
    else:
        columns = result.select_dtypes(
            include=["object", "category"]
        ).columns.tolist()

    if len(columns) == 0:
        return result

    encoder = OneHotEncoder(
        sparse_output=False,
        handle_unknown="ignore"
    )

    encoded = encoder.fit_transform(result[columns])

    encoded_df = pd.DataFrame(
        encoded,
        columns=encoder.get_feature_names_out(columns),
        index=result.index
    )

    result = result.drop(columns=columns)
    result = pd.concat([result, encoded_df], axis=1)
